title: Plane Agent is now in the Plane app
summary: Your AI teammate for payroll and HR no longer lives only in Slack. It's now available inside Plane and can work with files in both directions.
body_markdown:
## Files in, files out


The other change in this release: Plane Agent now works with attachments.


Send it a file, and it can read it. Drop in a signed contractor agreement and ask it to pull out the payment terms. Share a spreadsheet of proposed salary bands and ask how they compare to what you're currently paying.


It can also produce files. Ask for a payroll comparison across the last six months and get a spreadsheet or a PDF, whichever you prefer, and ask it to customize the file further to your liking. Request a headcount summary and get something you can drop straight into a board deck.


Before, Plane Agent could tell you the answer. Now, it can hand you a file in your preferred format and also analyze the files that you give it.


## How to turn it on


Plane Agent is currently still in beta. You can switch it on yourself today from the Features catalog.


[Log in](https://plane.com/login) to Plane and click[Features](https://app.plane.com/features) in the lower left of the sidebar. That's where new features land first, and where you can opt in while they're still in beta. Find Plane Agent, toggle it on, and it's available across your workspace.


## Getting started


Open[Features](https://app.plane.com/features) , switch on Plane Agent, and ask it something you'd otherwise have to go digging for.


If your team works in Slack, you can keep using it there, too. Your choice.


## Want to use Claude or ChatGPT instead? Connect to Plane’s MCP server.


The same features available in Plane Agent are available in Claude, ChatGPT, and any other MCP-compatible client. Simply add Plane to your favorite AI app as a connector (see details in our[MCP guide](https://docs.plane.com/guides/mcp) ), and it will be able to pull data from Plane when answering your questions. Ask Claude to help spot[attrition risk](https://plane.com/blog/ai-can-help-spot-attrition-risk) among your employees, or to build a[PTO dashboard](https://plane.com/blog/custom-pto-dashboard-with-ai) , based on your live Plane data.


Have suggestions or feedback on Plane Agent? We’d love to hear from you. Please feel free toget in touch with our team.
